answers.core: Godot's mobile editor is (From what I can tell) just the PC editor, ported to android. This makes it a slog to use on a phone. These changes should, in theory, make creating games with a phone MUCH easier out of the box. Also, I'm not entirely sure how an addon could change godot's UI so drastically.
answers.workaround: Maybe. Depending on how it is implemented, it could be a toggle in editor settings.
